ruleDefinitions.name: MSSQL XPCmdshell Suspicious Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when the MSSQL "xp_cmdshell" stored procedure is used to execute commands Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, Data

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = RGX(".*MSSQL.*") AND event_id = 33205 AND (Data = RGX(".*object\\_name\\:xp\\_cmdshell.*") AND Data = RGX(".*statement\\:EXEC.*")))
